title: Learning from the First Visual Pipeline Run
description: The first practical run establishes both a success and two defects. The pipeline produced 22,770 embeddings across 7,610 images after file-ID resolution was repaired and pgvector results were parsed into usable vectors.
body:
2026-02-26. The first practical run establishes both a success and two defects. The pipeline produced 22,770 embeddings across 7,610 images after file-ID resolution was repaired and pgvector results were parsed into usable vectors.

What this establishes

This is a dated implementation record. It establishes an evidence-backed next step without presenting the work as complete.

This outcome follows Making Visual Similarity Searchable and Letting Images Describe Themselves.

Historical basis: This entry is dated to the 2026-02-26 repository milestone, commit e094f71 and 470e4cc.
